authorization: Prepared for owner review after the single chroma DC trial was rejected. No new candidate image encode or quality configuration is authorized at this checkpoint.
hypothesis: The previous nonlinear DC trial changed InitialQuantDC allocation and reconstructed-luma chroma subtraction together with predictor-relative rounding. Test the rounding rule with aligned nominal allocation and original-luma chroma policy fixed.
changes: Restore aligned AC 1.25 nominal DC allocation from the archived DC-WIRE mode.
Use its existing serialized F16 DC matrix to set the quantizer step.
Apply libjxl QuantizeWP with the native dead zone and nonlinear residual rounding, including extra DC precision 1.
Preserve original-luma B-Y residuals, smoothing off, AC decisions and existing entropy selection.

checks.scope: Scalar and coefficient-plane checks only. No candidate image encoded, no quality score, bitrate, speed or original-memory result. Nominal allocation fixed; native nonlinear rounding includes one extra DC precision bit.

proposal.scope: Prepared proposal only. Restore aligned nominal AC 1.25 DC allocation and serialized matrix, apply native nonlinear predictor-relative rounding, preserve original-luma B-Y residual policy, smoothing off and AC decisions. No quality, bitrate, timing, original-memory or holdout result.

memory: Raw DC staging requires 12 bytes per 8x8 cell plus at most 10,416 bytes for one weighted predictor. This is a storage calculation, not measured encoder peak memory.
risks: The extra precision bit changes representable DC values even though nominal steps stay fixed.
Scalar error reduction has failed to predict SSIM improvement in earlier trials.
The existing local entropy selector may not exploit the predictor-relative rounding as native global weighted coding does.
Speed and original managed memory still require qualification if development quality passes.
decision: Owner decision requested for exactly one fixed predictor trial. No sweep, peer maps or holdout tuning; every gate unchanged. No full lab unless the screen justifies it.
